title: World Liquor 0.1.192: eject jukebox discs into the world
native_evidence_scope: Source regressions first reproduce empty-hand inventory delivery and full-inventory held-item refusal. Actual callbacks and the shared ejectRecord owner now cover world-item delivery, unchanged inventory, interaction admission, Java float drop position and failure recovery. Existing native sound/water/equipment/ground/fallDistance observations retain their original scope and are not rerun. A narrow QA-only real interaction observer is supplied for the common slot; it has not run. No full metadata, pickup-delay or native-input parity is claimed.
public_notes_inline: Manual jukebox ejection drops its disc into the world instead of Inventory.add, including a full inventory with a held item. Main/offhand secondary-use guards and Spectator admission remain native-like. One owner handles manual, destruction and explosion ejection with the Java world origin/float spread and retains recoverable saved state on delivery failure. Save formats, UUIDs and T201/G234 peer pins remain unchanged.
peer_pin_note: Exact T201 and G234 source pins. SDK copied from merged Tavern PR567; saved formats and UUIDs remain unchanged.
